plugins.name: recursive-self-improvement
plugins.description: Daily Opus-powered review of chat logs that identifies behavior patterns (north star violations, wellbeing drift, automatable meta-work) and writes actionable improvement proposals.

plugins.name: corrections-loop
plugins.description: Deterministic UserPromptSubmit hook that captures correction-shaped user messages into a local JSONL ledger for nightly triage. Regex-only, no LLM in the hot path, never blocks a session.

plugins.name: superpowers
plugins.description: Forked from obra/superpowers. Teaches Claude brainstorming, subagent driven development with built in code review, systematic debugging, and red/green TDD. Additionally, teaches Claude how to author and test new skills.
